name: EthnicityCategories
title: Ethnicity Categories
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description: The OID for this value set, used in the US Core Implementation Guide version 7.0 and earlier (http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/ValueSet/omb-ethnicity-category), has been retained. However, the VSAC-hosted version is now the preferred reference, as it serves as the authoritative source for both US Core and C-CDA and supports expansion for implementation.
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: This Grouping value set defines the concept codes used to represent ethnicity categories in alignment with the U.S. Office of Management and Budget’s (OMB) 1997 Statistical Policy Directive No. 15 (SPD-15). The standard identifies two federal ethnicity categories: Hispanic or Latino and Not Hispanic or Latino.

It also encompasses concept codes that capture situations in which ethnicity data is not available—such as when an individual is uncertain, chooses not to respond, or the information is otherwise unknown or unrecorded.),(Data Element Scope: Ethnicity category concept codes and concept codes representing reasons why an ethnicity category was not collected.),(Inclusion Criteria: Concept codes from the CDC Race and Ethnicity (CDCREC) code system representing the two federally required ethnicity categories, HL7 NullFlavor and Data Absent Reason concept codes.),(Exclusion Criteria: Detailed ethnicity concepts as defined in CDCREC.)
